title: High-efficiency solution-processed perovskite solar cells with millimeter-scale grains

extraction_issues.quote: The recent discovery of organic-inorganic pe- rovskites offers promis velopment of low-cost, solar-based clean global energy solutions for the future (
extraction_issues.reason: 句首在页尾中断，文字不完整（'promis velopment'），且句末括号未闭合，疑似跨页或提取拼接错误。

extraction_issues.quote: Our method leads to grain sizes as large as 1 to 2 mm, in comparison with the grain sizes of ~1 to 2 mm typically obtained using the conventional post-annealing process.
extraction_issues.reason: 传统后处理工艺通常得到微米级晶粒，而此处写成'~1 to 2 mm'与上下文（图1D、前文'~1 µm up to ~180 µm'）及常识矛盾，疑为'µm'误提取为'mm'。

extraction_issues.quote: We observed a marked increase in JSC (3.5 mA/cm2 to 22.4 mA/cm2), open-circuit voltage (VOC) (0.4 V to 0.92 V; fig. S8A), and fill factor (FF) (0.45 to 0.82; fig. S8B) when the grain size increased from ~1 mm up to ~180 mm
extraction_issues.reason: 晶粒尺寸单位应为µm（微米）而非mm（毫米），前文明确说明晶粒为'1 to 2 mm'是毫米级，且后续只从'~1 µm'到'~180 µm'，此处mm与上下文矛盾。

unverified_issue_candidates.quote: Figure 1, B to D, illustrates the obtained crystal grain structures using this hotcasting technique for various substrate temperatures and processing solvents.
unverified_issue_candidates.reason: 'hotcasting'缺少连字符，疑为提取合并错误；但此处不影响理解，标注存疑。

self_check: 已核对摘要与正文中的关键数值：PCE约18%（摘要）与正文'~18%'一致；JSC从3.5升至22.4 mA/cm²，VOC从0.4升至0.92 V，FF从0.45升至0.82，与Shockley-Queisser理论极限（JSC≈26.23, VOC≈1.02, FF≈0.90）方向一致；VOC-光强斜率1.0 kBT/q（大晶粒）与1.64 kBT/q（小晶粒）在摘要结论（抑制陷阱复合）上自洽。光致发光能量1.627 eV（发射）、1.653 eV（吸收）及蓝移25 meV、线宽展宽20 meV均保留原文数值。公式与符号（kBT/q）按原文保留。不确定处：第2页两处晶粒尺寸单位'mm'疑为'µm'之误，已在extraction_issues中标注；第1页引言句子跨页中断，未补充推测内容。正文中约450 nm膜厚、PbI2/MACl 1:1摩尔比、70°C溶液/180°C基底、旋涂15秒等关键实验条件均保留。
